comments.body:
Discovery Name: "Heptastadion"
Discovery Description: "A 1 kilometer long giant causeway that linked Pharos Island the Lighthouse of Alexandria was construted on and the mainland coast. Its name is based on its length, 'hepta' meaning seven and 'stadion' a Greek unit of length measuring approximately 180 meters."

Quest Name: Long Causeway
Skills Required: R6 Recognition, R8 Archaeology, Arabic

Quest Details: Alexandria with the island that the Lighthouse of Alexandria was built on. If it's something regarding one of the Seven Wonders of the World, I'm sure you'll be able to find more information about it at the Archives in Alexandria.

Quest obtained with 8-star clue from new Treasure Hunt Legend Regarding an Old Map

comments.body:

Alexandria Archives Read Archaeology x1
